contentText: Despite a minor scare, the Lions of Teranga remained calm, booking their spot in the quarter-finals of the Africa Cup of Nations. Two goals from Pape Gueye and an inspired performance from Paris Saint-Germain's young player Ibrahim Mbaye helped Senegal bring Sudan's Afcon campaign to an end. They will face Mali, who secured their place after a hard-fought match against Tunisia's Eagles of Carthage.
